title: CommandNotExecuted payload
description: A step expecting failure whose command exited 126 or 127: the status a shell gives when it could not execute the command or did not find it. Nothing was reproduced or refuted, as for a program the driver could not spawn itself, so nothing is submitted and the reason names the status (map.rs `CommandStep::verdict`, drive.rs `command_verdict`). Any other nonzero exit, 128 and above included, is still a reproduction: a crash reproduced through a shell exits that way, and cannot be told apart from a signal the shell reports.
